crossRefs.note: The children of Benjamin were counted on that day out of the cities twenty-six thousand men who drew the sword, in…
The men of Israel, besides Benjamin, were counted four hundred thousand men who drew sword. All these were men of war.
Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their armies with them, about fifteen thousand men, all who were left of all…
Joab gave up the sum of the counting of the people to the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant…
When the king of Moab saw that the battle was too severe for him, he took with him seven hundred men who drew a sword…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The chiefs of all the people, even of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen who drew sword.
translations.bsb: The leaders of all the people and all the tribes of Israel presented themselves in the assembly of God’s people: 400,000 men on foot, armed with swords.
translations.kjv: And the chief of all the people, even of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword.
translations.asv: And the chiefs of all the people, even of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword.
